open_formal_obligations.required: Construct the Moore polynomial algebra equivalence for a finite binary-field basis, check both inverse variable degrees and every filtered input span, and instantiate exact transport.
open_formal_obligations.status: Moore matrix invertibility and forward coordinate identities proved; construction and specialization of the polynomial algebra equivalence and filtered row replacement remain open.

open_formal_obligations.required: Construct terminating nonincreasing signed-digit normalization from every ordinary monomial and connect character grouping to the full-ideal upper bound.
open_formal_obligations.status: Written proof, local kernel identities, exhaustive/sampled finite traces; no all-length Lean normalization theorem.

open_formal_obligations.required: Formalize positive-word isolation, the square-chain normal form, character independence and the invariant excluding the alternating witness from the full iterated closure.
open_formal_obligations.status: Written proof and finite audits; not a universal Lean theorem.

open_formal_obligations.required: Instantiate the kernel local-to-global theorem with the actual arbitrary-coordinate S3 fiber selectors, then connect the worst-case dimension-budget corollary.
open_formal_obligations.status: Written theorem and kernel scalar fiber lemmas; selector section remains open.

review_questions: Does normalization terminate for every cycle length with the claimed ordinary-degree budget?
Does the lower invariant handle every newly derived lower-degree row and wraparound carry?
Do all coordinate and coefficient-field changes preserve the full input filtration?
Which exact LFD consequences extend the checked HKYY, Preparata, CG and HFE sources?

fully_formalized_statements: LFD <= max(m*k+1, delta) for every input list containing the chains
LFD <= 2k+1 for the normalized two-summand prime presentation at every depth
binary/Koblitz descended S3 systems LFD <= r+1

LFD <= k+2 for the normalized two-summand chain presentation on every nonsingular cubic, every target and every depth k >= 2, over every field with 2 != 0 (Theorem thm:selector); LFD = 4 at k = 2 for unit ideals with 3t^2+a != 0
LFD >= 4 for every unit-ideal two-summand chain system with 3t^2+a != 0, at every depth k >= 2 (Theorem thm:three)
LFD >= 7 for three-summand chain systems with the chain normal form of S_4, at every depth k >= 3, when 5t^3+3at+6b != 0 (Theorem thm:carry)
first fall degree of the two-summand prime systems is 3 or 4 at every depth k >= 2 (an FFD statement, not an LFD one)
an exclusion of 1 from the degree-D closure at depth k persists at every larger depth, so unit-ideal instances there have LFD > D (Theorem thm:restrict)
written_only: the local-to-global rank certificate for prime chains is the same argument as the Boolean one and is instantiated in Python, not in Lean
characteristic-two validity of the chain statement (Buchberger coprime criterion) is not formalized
